Elite ENT Center

Design system

A restrained foundation for medical communication: navy for authority, white for clarity, and a single clinical blue for interaction. Every page should feel calm, legible, and precise.

Version 1.0 · November 2026 · Light theme

01 — Color

A quiet palette with one clear accent

White carries the page. Navy anchors headings and primary actions. Azure is reserved for links, focus, and informational emphasis. Status colors appear only when they communicate status.

02 — Typography

Serif authority, sans-serif clarity

Source Serif 4 is used only for display headings, where it adds a measured, established tone. Inter carries body copy, labels, buttons, and data. Numbers in clinical records use tabular figures.

03 — Spacing & layout

A 4px rhythm from control to page

Component interiors use the 4px scale. Page rhythm uses two fluid section tokens, and the page shell uses fluid gutters. Nothing is positioned by eye.

04 — Borders, radii & shadows

Visible structure, minimal ornament

One-pixel hairlines define most structure. Radii are restrained and consistent: controls at 8px, cards at 12px, pills only for small indicators. Elevation is subtle and navy-tinted.

05 — Buttons

One primary action at a time

Buttons are 36, 44, or 48 pixels tall; the default 44px meets the minimum touch target. Primary is navy, secondary is outlined, soft is a quiet blue fill, and destructive is reserved for irreversible actions.

Variants

Sizes

Disabled

06 — Form controls

Labels that stay visible, errors that explain

Every control is 44px tall with a 3:1 border against white. Labels sit above the control, hints and errors below. Focus is a soft azure ring; invalid fields switch to the destructive color and expose aria-invalid.

As it appears on your medical record.

Enter a valid email address.

Include when symptoms started and whether they affect one or both sides.

07 — Cards

Grouped information with one purpose

Cards use a white surface, a hairline border, 12px radius, and a 24px interior. They hold one topic and should not nest. Elevation stays at shadow-xs unless the card is genuinely raised above the page.

08 — Icons

A single outline family

Icons come from Lucide at a 1.5 stroke weight. Use 16px inline with small text, 20px with controls, and 24px for navigation or section markers. Icons support comprehension; they never replace a label.

09 — Responsive rules

Calm at every width

Layouts reorganize, they do not shrink. Display type is fluid so headings never need separate mobile sizes. Controls keep a 44px target, and body copy never falls below 16px.

Breakpoints

sm
640px
Two-column forms, larger gutters
md
768px
Side-by-side content, wider cards
lg
1024px
Three-column grids, inline navigation
xl
1280px
Full page width, generous whitespace
2xl
1536px
Maximum container, no further growth

Rules

  • Use the page-container utility for every page shell; it supplies the max width and fluid gutters.
  • Start single-column. Introduce grids at sm and md, not below.
  • Keep one primary action visible on small screens; move secondary actions below or into a menu.
  • Do not hide essential clinical information behind hover or horizontal scroll.
  • Maintain 44px touch targets and 8px minimum spacing between adjacent controls.
  • Cap body copy at 65 to 75 characters and never justify text.
  • Prefer two columns for forms and cards at md, three only at lg and above.
